description: This file contains the implementation of the 'DefaultSupervisedStream' class, which implements the 'SupervisedStream' interface. It manages a streaming process with capabilities to shutdown, abort, and handle completion with error notifications.

classes.name: DefaultSupervisedStream
classes.description: Implementation of {@link org.eclipse.ditto.services.gateway.streaming.actors.SupervisedStream} that manages stream lifecycle.

methods.name: whenComplete
methods.description: Handles the completion of the stream, executing the provided error consumer if an error occurs.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the supervised stream by invoking the kill switch.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the stream with the given error using the kill switch.
